sentences.text:
Applicant :- Rajesh Kumar
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And Anr.

Counsel for Applicant :- Gopesh Tripathi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Govt. Advocate
Hon'ble Arvind Singh Sangwan,J.
1.

This petition has been filed with the prayer to quash the proceedings of Case No. 924 of 2010
(State vs. Rajesh Kumar) pending in the Court of 1st A.C.J.M. Court No.11, Raebareli arising out of
Case Crime No. 112 of 1999 under Section 272/273 of Ipc relating to P.S. Maharajganj, District
Raebareli.

entities.text: Court of 1st A.C.J.M. Court No.11, Raebareli
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2.  Counsel for the petitioner submits that a sample was drawn on 25.5.1999 which was sent for verification before the concerned lab which has given adverse report on 3.7.1999.

Later on, when complaint was filed under Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, the petitioner exercised his right for re-analyzing the second sample before the Central Food Laboratory, Mysore,
wherein, no adulteration was found in the milk sample taken from the petitioner.

The counsel has placed reliance on record the order dated 5.12.2023 passed by the the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Raebareli vide which on the basis of the same, the petitioner stands acquitted in the complaint under Section 7/16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.

This order is taken on record as Mark 'X'.
3. Counsel submits that in terms of this order, subsequent prosecution under section 272 & 273 of IPC is legally not sustainable as the same is based on the erroneous report of the concerned lab which has been disbelieved by the competent Court of law.
Rajesh Kumar vs State Of U.P. And Anr.

entities.text: Rajesh Kumar vs State Of U.P. And Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Learned A.G.A. for the State could not dispute the factual position.

5. In view of the above, all the proceedings of case No. 924 of 2010 as well as the Case Crime No. 112 of 1999 are quashed and set aside.
6.
